response.original_title: This Video is on Letterboxd + More
response.overview: In this epic tale, join Lorenzo as he traverses the world of "Letterboxd," to uncover the hidden relationship it has with 'YouTube' videos. Along the way, he makes some unbelievable discoveries, such as the only let's play on the site, "Mickey Mousecapade," uploaded by the Game Grumps, a hallucinogenic trip into the mind of Markiplier, and a beautiful film about Godzilla's child coming out as transgender. What else will he discover in this legendary odyssey?
response.tagline: Letterboxd and YouTube's relationship...has been exposed
